_: Life in the 16 Bold Cities: who lives there, the hosts they gather in, what they post (each post pinned to its city and zone) and what they say. Every resident is fictional: first names and surnames are drawn from characters of classic films and paired anew, so no resident is a film's character. app/phiegg/scripts/city-life.py reads this after bold-cities.py and rewrites only records marked origin city-life.
_ladder: How many of a thing a record has is a rung of `ladder`, so lists come in every size (16, 32, 64, 128, 256). `spread` says how sixteen records in a row sit on it: six on the first rung, four on the second, three, two, and one on the last. It sets the comments and likes of each post, the people going to each event, and who follows and is followed by each resident.

_events: What happens in each city, `eventsPerCity` of them: `place` is one of the hosts' places (the event is held in that host's zone), `day` the days after `eventsFrom`, `time` the hour (UTC). A drop has a price (ETH) and a supply; a party a genre; a yearly event says when it comes back.
